name: one-coworking
description: Find and compare coworking spaces, meeting rooms and private offices in 300+ European cities, with booking links.

interface.longDescription: One Coworking lists 2,300+ coworking spaces and flexible offices in 300+ European cities. Ask for a day pass or a meeting room and get the spaces near a station, hotel or street you name, ranked by walking minutes, each with a link to its page on One Coworking with your date and party size filled in. Looking for an office for a team? One Coworking asks the questions a broker would — team size now and in a year, areas, budget, move-in date, term — and returns a shortlist of the well-known brands and the local operators that fit, with list prices per desk and what to watch. It also shows typical prices per city (day pass, desk, private office, meeting room) and, for teams spread across several cities, what they can book instantly in each. Everything comes from the same live listings as onecoworking.com. Bookings and office requests are completed on onecoworking.com.
defaultPrompt: Find a coworking day pass near Berlin Hauptbahnhof for tomorrow.
We are 8 people and need a private office in Munich.
What does a meeting room cost per hour in Lisbon?

positive.prompt: Find a coworking day pass near Berlin Hauptbahnhof for next Tuesday for 2 people.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 3 Berlin spaces within a short walk of Hauptbahnhof with walking minutes, each with a link to its One Coworking venue page with the date and party size filled in; says which book instantly and which confirm on request.

positive.prompt: We are a team of 8 and need a private office in Munich, Maxvorstadt, budget around 6,000 EUR a month, from January for a year.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks any open questions (growth, room with a door or desks, must-haves), then shows a shortlist of well-known brands and local operators in or near Maxvorstadt with list prices per desk and why each fits; explains that today's prices are requested on onecoworking.com.

positive.prompt: What does a meeting room cost per hour in Lisbon, and a day pass?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the typical range (10th to 90th percentile) and the median for meeting rooms per hour and day passes per day in Lisbon, from live listings.

positive.prompt: Tell me about betahaus Barcelona: prices, opening hours and amenities.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the venue's address, district, starting prices with units, opening hours, amenities and how to book, with a link to its venue page.

positive.prompt: Our team works from Berlin, Hamburg and Lisbon. What could we book instantly with a One Coworking team account?
positive.expected_behavior: For each city, the number of spaces with an instantly bookable day pass, their median day-pass price and how many also have bookable meeting rooms, plus the team account terms.

negative.prompt: Book a day pass at a space in Berlin for me and pay with my card right here.

negative.description: An action the plugin has no tool for
negative.prompt: Cancel my One Coworking booking for tomorrow at betahaus Kreuzberg.
Find me a hotel room in Paris for tonight.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. Its links open One Coworking venue pages, where people book and pay on onecoworking.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: search spaces, spaces near a place, booking links, office shortlists, city prices and team coverage.
